category.name: Technology
category.description: Perangkat, perangkat lunak, dan istilah digital.

words.definition: A machine or tool made for a particular purpose.
words.example: This app works on any Android device.
words.example_id: Aplikasi ini berjalan di perangkat Android apa pun.

words.definition: Programs that run on a computer.
words.example: We updated the software last night.
words.example_id: Kami memperbarui perangkat lunak tadi malam.

words.definition: To copy files from the internet to your device.
words.example: Download the file before you leave.

words.definition: A copy of data kept in case the original is lost.
words.example: Always keep a backup of your notes.

words.definition: To make something more modern or current.
words.example: Please update the app to the latest version.
words.example_id: Mohon perbarui aplikasi ke versi terbaru.

words.definition: To convert data into a code so others cannot read it.
The amount of data that can be sent at one time.
words.example: Video calls use a lot of bandwidth.
words.example_id: Panggilan video memakai banyak lebar pita.

words.definition: A person who uses a product or service.
words.example: Every user has a personal profile.

words.definition: An important part or function of a product.
words.example: Dark mode is my favourite feature.
words.example_id: Mode gelap adalah fitur favorit saya.

words.definition: To find and fix errors in a program.
words.example: He spent the night debugging the app.
words.example_id: Dia sepanjang malam mencari kesalahan aplikasi itu.
